description.en: State diagram tasks like the second midterm's, with model solutions.

question.en: Draw the state diagram for objects of the class Ingredient. After a new ingredient is procured, its initial state is "available". In this state, it can be used to produce different chocolates, and after each use, its quantity is reduced. An available ingredient can be "reserved" for a specific chocolate, and in this state, it can no longer be added to other chocolates. If the ingredient is completely used up (its quantity becomes 0), it becomes "unavailable". An ingredient that is unavailable can be procured again and become available, or it may no longer be procured, in which case it becomes "withdrawn from use".

question.en: Draw a state diagram for the states of the tax return documents generated in the system “e-personal tax”. Each year in March the registered users in the system get a document for tax return which should be confirmed or corrected. The first status of the sent document is “waiting for user confirmation”. The users can either confirm the document, or make some changes. If the document is confirmed, its status is changed to “accepted”, while if there are changes made the new status is “changed – waiting for admin confirmation”. From this state, if the changes are confirmed by the admin, the document gets the status “accepted”, while if the changes are rejected it goes back to the state of “waiting for user confirmation”.

question.en: Draw a state diagram for the time slots for museum visits: When a new time slot for a museum visit is defined, its initial state is “available”. In this state, the user still cannot reserve or buy a ticket for a visit. Depending on the admin decision, the time slot can be made available only for ticket reservation (state “available for ticket reservation”) or only for buying tickets (state “available for buying a ticket”). Only premium users can reserve tickets. If a non-premium user tries to reserve a ticket in the state “available for ticket reservation” he/she is added to the wait list. A time slot that is available for ticket reservation after a period can be made available only for buying a ticket, but not otherwise. When a time slot is available for buying a ticket, a notification is sent to the users in the wait list.

question.en: Draw a state diagram for the following text: When a new application for accommodation in student dorm is created, its initial status is "created". In this state, the student can still edit the application. The application remains in the "created" state until the student submits it. Once the student submits the application, its status changes to "submitted", and it can no longer be changed. A "submitted" application can then become "accepted" or "rejected" by an administrator's decision. An application that has been "accepted" can be marked as "confirmed" if the student accepts the assigned room within the given deadline, or as "rejected by student" if the student refuses the accommodation.
